name: appmap-react
description: AppMap agent for React (browser) and Deno edge functions: records AppMap v1.12 and links frontend AppMaps to backend AppMaps via W3C Trace Context.

scripts.link:demo: npm test --workspace examples/petclinic-react && node linker/bin/simulate-backend.mjs examples/petclinic-react/tmp/appmap/tests --out examples/petclinic-react/tmp/appmap/backend && node linker/bin/appmap-link.mjs examples/petclinic-react/tmp/appmap --out examples/petclinic-react/tmp/appmap/links
